# section: # Close the inner tape once, before any enclosing binary payload is captured.
# Filenames are current logical include/#line names; the unit number remains the TU.
# Caller supplies tf_unit and tf_filename; only tf_* scratch registers are modified.
# Compare blob contents without INTERN: frame names must never consume E3 symbol ids.
# An explicit empty logical filename clears the old context with B=0; it is
# not the missing CLI resource and never requires dereferencing a zero blob.
# Resolve through the diagnostic mapper without emitting diagnostics. This is a
# separate call so instruction emitters never insert metadata into partial lines.
# UNIT_MAP directory occupies slots 0..1023. Each TU bank reserves offset
# 1024 for readiness and 1025+floor(byte/1024) for physical line checkpoints.
# Signed LE32 source extents need fewer than 2^21 checkpoints per bank.
# Monotone same-source queries scan each byte once; backtracking uses checkpoints.
# Only the exact legacy UNITOK1 sentinel falls back to the CLI resource;
# an explicit DP empty filename is passed through and emits .unit N 0:.
# Only TF.prepare touches SB, before the original E3 start; current-frame hooks
# use the prefetched source blob and preserve the caller's live string buffer.
